purpose: Portable, loss-minimizing programming-language and ecosystem knowledge catalog for LLM ingestion.

governance.preservation_rule: Never discard a discovered source record merely because it duplicates another identity. Preserve evidence; link identities separately.
governance.normalization_rule: Normalize names/categories without overwriting raw source evidence.
governance.deduplication_rule: Deduplicate canonical identities, not evidence records.
governance.uncertainty_rule: Unknown, stale, inferred, deprecated and unverified states remain explicit.
governance.record_granularity: Tools/packages/projects/specifications are top-level identities; individual lint rules/API symbols are subordinate unless independently useful.
governance.streaming_rule: Future harvests append evidence/identity records directly to this master; do not create another wrapper extract.

statistics.note: Dense portable corpus: inherited evidence + model-known engineering catalog + web-search evidence. Unverified model seeds are explicitly marked and are not falsely presented as web-verified.
